_what_this_is: Permanent content findings in an append-only ledger, each with the reason it cannot be repaired. An unacknowledged finding blocks consolidation; an acknowledged one is reported and does not. A stale entry - one naming an event that no longer produces a finding - is itself an error, so this file cannot accumulate cover for problems that are gone.
_what_it_is_not: A silencer. Chain breaks, sequence breaks, anchor regressions and a view that is not the replay of its sources are STRUCTURAL and block regardless of anything written here, because all four are repairable by restoring a file or rebuilding the view.
_note_on_keys: Keyed <event_id>:<kind>, because one event can produce several findings and a reason written about one of them must not excuse the others. A bare event id still matches, but only where that event produces exactly one finding.

events.EV-orchestrator-0039:type-mismatch: A REVIEW_CLOSED aimed at EV-orchestrator-0037, which is the TASK_ASSIGNED for TASK-REACH-REPAIR, not the REVIEW_OPENED it meant. The review it records did happen: blind Mirror round 1 bound to tip 14e4ad9, BLOCK with four findings, all repaired in 7fcbde3. The linkage is wrong and append-only keeps it. This is the SECOND hand-passed id mistyped in this session and the third mis-linked closure overall, which is why `--closes` is now derived from the task rather than carried by hand between two commands.
events.EV-orchestrator-0041:task-boundary: A TASK_COMPLETE for TASK-GUARD52-A that closes EV-orchestrator-0021, the opening of TASK-GUARD52-B. The completion it records is real - aa205d6 - and it is attached to the wrong opening, so GUARD52-B briefly read as closed while GUARD52-A read as open. Corrected by EV-orchestrator-0042, which closes EV-orchestrator-0020, the right opening - and that id is written here after reading it back, unlike the two before it. A side effect is permanent: TASK-GUARD52-B's opening now counts as closed by a wrong event, so its real completion is recorded as a CHECKPOINT_WRITTEN rather than a second closure, because fabricating one would be a double closure and the queue would then be right for a reason that is false. The consolidator refused to advance until both findings were named individually, which is the acknowledgement repair of 7fcbde3 working on its author within the hour.
events.EV-orchestrator-0029: Mistyped `--closes`: this REVIEW_CLOSED names EV-orchestrator-0013, a TASK_CLAIMED belonging to another task, where it meant EV-orchestrator-0015, the REVIEW_OPENED it actually closes. The consolidator caught it on the third use of the tool, against its own author. The ledger is append-only, so the wrong id cannot be edited out and no later event can retract it; EV-orchestrator-0032 carries the correct linkage. The queue is unaffected: `open_tasks` counts only closures whose type may close a TASK_ASSIGNED, so a REVIEW_CLOSED never evicted anything. EV-orchestrator-0030/0031 are duplicates of 0033/0034 - the first batch's appends all succeeded before consolidation refused, and append-only keeps both. This reason first named 0030 as the correction and was wrong: the id was written without being read back, which is the same error as EV-orchestrator-0002's, forty minutes later.
